title: Christ’s Victory Over Satan
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Christ’s victory over Satan means that through His death, resurrection, and reign, Jesus has defeated the devil’s condemning power and will finally destroy his works.
summary: Christ’s victory over Satan means that through His death, resurrection, and reign, Jesus has defeated the devil’s condemning power and will finally destroy his works.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the promised Victor who crushes the serpent, disarms the powers, frees captives, and secures the final defeat of Satan.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
From the beginning, God promised that the seed of the woman would crush the serpent. The whole story of redemption moves toward Christ’s victory over sin, Satan, and death.

At the cross, what looked like defeat became triumph. Christ canceled the record of debt, disarmed rulers and authorities, and put them to open shame. His death breaks the devil’s condemning power.

Through resurrection, Jesus triumphs over death and frees those held in fear. Satan still opposes, tempts, and accuses, but he does so as a defeated enemy awaiting final judgment.

The believer’s confidence in spiritual warfare is Christ’s victory. God’s people overcome by the blood of the Lamb and the word of their testimony, not by personal strength.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
This doctrine keeps believers from despair in spiritual battle. Satan is real, but his defeat is also real. The cross is not merely forgiveness; it is victory.

It also keeps spiritual warfare Gospel-centered. The believer does not boast in power, technique, or experience, but in the crucified and risen Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Fight from Christ’s victory, not for your own glory. When accused, tempted, or afraid, return to the cross and resurrection. Trust that Jesus has broken the enemy’s condemning claim and will finally destroy every work of darkness.
